#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate and verify a replayable RoboWits ball-into-jar trajectory."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from rcb_robowits import Session


OUT = Path("/app/output")
INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"


def main():
    s = Session("ball_into_jar", instance=INSTANCE)
    p = s.primitives()
    print("initial", s.objects(), flush=True)
    s.record_start()

    # The foam starts with horizontal velocity. Let it roll to rest first, then
    # use the observed settled position for the grasp.
    p["hold"](60)
    ball_pos = np.asarray(s.objects()["foam ball"]["position"], dtype=float)
    _, q = s.ee_pose("right")
    print("settled", ball_pos, flush=True)
    p["move_ee"]("right", [ball_pos[0], ball_pos[1], ball_pos[2]], q,
                 max_dq=0.025, settle=20, tol=0.025)
    print("at ball", s.objects()["foam ball"], s.ee_pose("right")[0], flush=True)
    p["close_gripper"]("right", 35)
    p["hold"](15)
    grasp_state = s.objects()["foam ball"]
    print("grasp", grasp_state, flush=True)

    # Lift, then carry above the jar and lower through its mouth.
    p["move_ee"]("right", [ball_pos[0], ball_pos[1], 1.02], q,
                 max_dq=0.025, settle=20, tol=0.025)
    print("lifted", s.objects()["foam ball"], flush=True)
    q = p["top_down_quat"](np.pi / 2)
    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.612, -0.128, 1.02], q, linear=5,
                 max_dq=0.025, settle=20, tol=0.025)
    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.612, -0.128, 0.83], q, linear=5,
                 max_dq=0.025, settle=20, tol=0.025)
    p["hold"](10)
    print("lowered", s.objects()["foam ball"], flush=True)
    p["open_gripper"]("right", 30)
    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.612, -0.128, 1.02], q, linear=5, max_dq=0.025, settle=20, tol=0.025)
    p["hold"](60)
    status = s.status()
    print("after release", s.objects()["foam ball"], status, flush=True)

    actions = s.record_stop()
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print("saved", len(actions), flush=True)
    if status["success"]:
        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz")
        print("replay", s.replay(actions), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate and verify a replayable RoboWits ball-into-jar trajectory."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from rcb_robowits import Session


OUT = Path("/app/output")
INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"


def main():
    s = Session("ball_into_jar", instance=INSTANCE)
    p = s.primitives()
    print("initial", s.objects(), flush=True)
    s.record_start()

    # Let the foam roll to rest, then push it from its southwest side toward
    # the jar with a closed horizontal gripper.
    p["hold"](60)
    ball_pos = np.asarray(s.objects()["foam ball"]["position"], dtype=float)
    print("settled", ball_pos, flush=True)
    q0 = s.ee_pose("right")[1]
    q = p["gripper_quat"](np.pi / 2, approach=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    start = [ball_pos[0] - 0.12, ball_pos[1] - 0.12]
    q_start_high, eh, rh = s.ik("right", [start[0], start[1], 1.02], q)
    q_start_low, el, rl = s.ik("right", [start[0], start[1], 0.82], q)
    print("start IK", (eh, rh), (el, rl), flush=True)
    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.625, -0.290, 1.12], q0,
                 max_dq=0.025, settle=15, tol=0.025)
    p["move_joints"]("right", q_start_high, max_dq=0.02, settle=20)
    p["close_gripper"]("right", 20)
    p["move_joints"]("right", q_start_low, max_dq=0.02, settle=15)
    print("push start", s.objects()["foam ball"], s.ee_pose("right")[0], flush=True)

    waypoints = [
        [ball_pos[0] - 0.03, ball_pos[1] - 0.03, 0.82],
        [0.48, -0.20, 0.82],
        [0.54, -0.16, 0.82],
        [0.60, -0.13, 0.82],
        [0.612, -0.128, 0.80],
    ]
    q_waypoints = []
    for wp in waypoints:
        qw, ep, er = s.ik("right", wp, q)
        q_waypoints.append(qw)
        print("push IK", wp, ep, er, flush=True)
    for wp, qw in zip(waypoints, q_waypoints):
        p["move_joints"]("right", qw, max_dq=0.015, settle=15)
        print("pushed", wp, s.objects()["foam ball"]["position"], flush=True)
    p["hold"](60)
    p["hold"](60)
    status = s.status()
    print("after release", s.objects()["foam ball"], status, flush=True)

    actions = s.record_stop()
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print("saved", len(actions), flush=True)
    if status["success"]:
        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz")
        print("replay", s.replay(actions), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
